verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents its own least-privilege mechanism: RBAC, where privileges are assigned to roles and roles to users. The SQL API can provision users and roles, so a narrowly scoped identity for an agent can be created programmatically, and the managed MCP server claims agents can retrieve data securely. However, nothing in the pack documents actually issuing API credentials (tokens, keys, or service-user secrets) or binding them to a restricted role for agent use. Missing for 10: documented issuance of scoped API tokens/keys for agents, credential expiry/revocation controls, per-credential scope binding, independent or hands-on corroboration.
